artifacts.title: Schelling segregation model: a playable agent-based model
artifacts.description: The 1971 Schelling segregation model as a grid you can run. Two groups of agents, a slider for how many similar neighbours each agent wants, Step and Run buttons, and a chart of how neighbourhoods sort over time. The model code is a separate file that the Build Lab test harness checks in Node.
artifacts.author: Machine Spirits

artifacts.title: Spotlight: a short journey into attention
artifacts.description: Fourteen screens, one idea each, something to touch on every one. Finish a sentence, then watch a machine do it; share out one pie of attention; ask a question and let the name tags answer; nudge a model as it learns by guessing; meet the three parts of your own attention; then run a feed for three rounds and read the bill. Built for readers with no technical background. The full ten-chapter lab is one link away.
artifacts.author: Machine Spirits

artifacts.title: Spotlight Lab: attention in depth, ten chapters
artifacts.description: Spotlight: attention in machines, readers and society, in ten guided chapters. Part I introduces Vaswani et al. 2017 and the first attention mechanism (the formula in four steps, a next-word animation, query/key/value, six puzzles, training versus inference, a numerical inspector); Part II the three human attention systems of Petersen and Posner 2012 on a cortical model; Part III the same sentence read by both; Part IV Terranova’s attention economy as a playable loop where a trained writer, 120 readers and a ledger retrain each other. Every chapter has a one-minute primer, a what-to-do list and a take-away. Includes the Week 4 lecture slides with deep dives.

probes.title: Probe 01 — Recognition under correction
probes.summary: A runnable dialogue probe that asks whether an AI tutor merely repairs an answer after a learner objects, or treats the objection as evidence that can change the shared account of the problem.

probes.title: Probe 02 — Suspended judgment
probes.summary: A runnable dialogue probe for whether an AI tutor pauses when a learner's difficulty supports several explanations, or prematurely commits to one diagnosis and teaches past the uncertainty.
